2-moving-average.why: buy decision at day i uses the short/long MA that includes close[i]; agents 1, 2 and 3 all trade at the close they observe (same-close convention, not look-ahead of future prices). This 1-day-delayed run for agent 2 is a sensitivity check.

23-abcd-strategy.why: buy day a is signalled from ma[b], ma[c], ma[d] with b>=a, c>=b, d>=c (step 4), so the pattern is only knowable on day d; min d-a = 12 days
